name: io.github.llmsresearch/paperbanana
title: PaperBanana
description: Generate academic figures, statistical plots, and venue-compliant conference posters (PNG + print-ready PDF, with the paper's real figures) from text or a paper PDF, using multi-agent AI.

tools.name: generate_diagram
tools.description: Generate a methodology diagram from text context and caption

tools.name: generate_plot
tools.description: Generate a statistical plot from JSON data and intent description

tools.name: generate_poster
tools.description: Generate a venue-compliant conference poster (PNG + print-ready PDF) from a paper PDF, with the paper's real figures embedded and a faithfulness audit

tools.name: continue_run
tools.description: Continue refinement for an existing run directory (optional critic feedback)

tools.name: orchestrate_figures
tools.description: Plan and generate a full-paper figure package from a paper

tools.name: evaluate_diagram
tools.description: Compare a generated diagram against a human reference on 4 dimensions

tools.name: evaluate_plot
tools.description: Compare a generated statistical plot against a human reference on 4 dimensions
